hypotheses.claim: range_url or password_occurrences leaks the full SHA-1 or tenant-identifying data in the outbound HIBP request.
hypotheses.reason: range_url interpolates only digest.prefix(); tests assert suffix never appears in URL; client disables redirects and sends Add-Padding only.

hypotheses.claim: On range transport failure during breach-check, error.to_string() embeds the range URL path (five hex prefix) in breach.scan.failed detail visible to security subscribers.
hypotheses.reason: Plausible bucket-id hint in event detail for org admins, not plaintext password; scanner/delivery paths use failure_text::transport elsewhere; prefix alone is k-anonymity by design. Hardening only.

hypotheses.claim: A member session can run breach-check against another organization's findings or exfiltrate sealed secrets via password_occurrences.
hypotheses.reason: authorize requires can_configure_integrations; resolve_caller_organization forbids x-opensesame-organization on sessions; validate binds subject to caller org; scanner never calls password_occurrences.

result_one_line: HIBP range fetch is prefix-only with padding and no redirects; breach-check is owner/admin/operator-gated with org-bound subjects and fails closed on corpus errors.

hypotheses.claim: Presenting Bearer opaque-session: with agent-capability claims bypasses agent_grants ceiling checks via require_session alone.
hypotheses.reason: require_session enforces credential_kind vs bearer prefix pairing (agent-capability spelling, no DPoP for agents); router applies agent_grants guard before handlers.

hypotheses.claim: A session can select another tenant via x-opensesame-organization while resolve_caller still returns Session.
hypotheses.reason: resolve_caller_organization returns FORBIDDEN when a session sends the operator organization header.

hypotheses.claim: resolve_caller falls through to operator when session is almost valid, granting Operator owns_subject everywhere.
hypotheses.reason: resolve_caller returns Session only when require_session succeeds fully; invalid binding or claims reject before operator path is considered.

result_one_line: Sessions are digest-keyed with strict DPoP/agent binding; resolve_caller is session-first and sessions cannot set x-opensesame-organization.

hypotheses.claim: read_hook_records returns another org's hook records when run_id is guessed.
hypotheses.reason: load resolves caller org, fetches run in that org only, authorize_attach returns 404 for non-owners; DB query scopes organization_id.

hypotheses.claim: Browser grant sessions read hook records without host.agent.observe and role-evidence floor.
hypotheses.reason: load calls ensure_view_authority for Attachment::View, which re-validates browser grant ceiling and role_policy evidence.

result_one_line: Hook records are owner-gated like log reads, payload-free rows, with browser observe ceiling on View attachment.

hypotheses.claim: commit applies control transitions without consuming a purpose-bound host authorization elevation digest.
hypotheses.reason: commit requires 64-hex elevation and control_with_host_authorization atomically consumes matching authorized row before versioned run update.

hypotheses.claim: Two gateways can both take control when expected_version races because elevation is not single-use.
hypotheses.reason: Authorization row moves to consumed in same transaction as observation_runs UPDATE ... AND version=?; zero rows yields Ok(false) and CONFLICT.

result_one_line: Control commits require fresh WebAuthn-backed elevation consumed in-transaction with optimistic run version CAS.

hypotheses.claim: observe SSE keeps streaming sealed log after session or grant revocation because StreamAuthority is captured once.
hypotheses.reason: tail loop calls authority.active before each poll batch; active re-reads grant/session and re-checks owner_principal_id.

hypotheses.claim: observe decrypts sealed_payload for clients lacking viewer keys.
hypotheses.reason: SSE and read_log base64 relay ciphertext only; comments and JSON mark sealed true and secrets_returned false.

result_one_line: Observe tails re-validate StreamAuthority each poll and relay ciphertext only; AgentCapability cannot pass active().

hypotheses.claim: Operator caller can get_run and learn another principal's sandbox metadata.
hypotheses.reason: authorize_attach maps Operator to ViewerRelation::Operator but relation for session must be CredentialOwner; operator gets 404 via refusal mapping for non-owner attach.

hypotheses.claim: list_runs exposes all organization runs to any member.
hypotheses.reason: list filters to ViewerRelation::CredentialOwner only after tenant listing.

result_one_line: get_run uses load(View) with owner-only attach and hook summary counts only; operators cannot enumerate others' runs.

hypotheses.claim: Organization member can POST issue authority on grants without integration admin role.
hypotheses.reason: authorize_realm requires can_configure_integrations and path organization must match resolve_caller_organization.

hypotheses.claim: Admin session can mint credential.export via issue without owner/operator.
hypotheses.reason: entries_include_reserved triggers may_issue_reserved_administration which is false for non-owner admin sessions.

hypotheses.claim: authorize_authority_use still checks grant.actions.first instead of requested action.
hypotheses.reason: Engine path requires requested_action and denies when not in grant.actions; materialize uses separate class.

result_one_line: Authority issue is owner/admin in-path org with reserved-action gating; exercise checks named action against grant and egress binding.

hypotheses.claim: Vault session can read or change backup target and learn gateway-wide outbox depth.
hypotheses.reason: require_configurator calls require_operator only; member sessions never reach handlers (401 in tests).

hypotheses.claim: PutTargetBody.config can smuggle tokens into backup target JSON persisted in DB.
hypotheses.reason: config_has_secret_shaped_key recursively refuses keys matching token/password/bearer patterns.

result_one_line: Backup routes are operator-only; config rejects secret-shaped keys and does not return credential material.

hypotheses.claim: create accepts host.connections.write or other high caps before passkey verification.
hypotheses.reason: allowed_capabilities permits only host.join alone or host.sync.read/write pair; verified_ceiling widens only after approval path.

hypotheses.claim: Attacker can create pairings without DPoP proof binding to origin.
hypotheses.reason: create awaits validate on POST /api/v1/browser-pairings with origin and jkt from proof verification.

result_one_line: Pairing create is DPoP-bound and rate-limited; capability ceiling is closed until passkey verification expands it.

hypotheses.claim: present endpoint wrongly requires session, blocking intentional token-only spend.
hypotheses.reason: present intentionally has no resolve_caller; claim requires session to bind delegate subject at exercise time.

hypotheses.claim: mint or claim accepts principal from JSON body instead of transport subject.
hypotheses.reason: caller_subject is always from resolve_caller Session or operator demo id; broker mint_delegation_offer takes organization and subject parameters from gateway only.

result_one_line: Delegation HTTP layer binds subjects from auth only; present is token-gated and claim requires session; broker enforces fences.

hypotheses.claim: Unauthenticated attacker can brute-force user_code to approve arbitrary device logins.
hypotheses.reason: approve requires operator; global MAX_APPROVE_FAILURES per minute with per-device digest binding for guesses.

hypotheses.claim: Operator approve can mint session for arbitrary principal without validation.
hypotheses.reason: principal must parse via parse_principal; organization claims must be complete or demo bootstrap default; token binds approved principal not bootstrap alone.

result_one_line: Device flow limits clients and scopes; approve is operator-only with rate-limited user_code checks and parsed principal binding.

hypotheses.claim: NATS CONNECT project_ids widen evaluate_callout permissions without Identity mapping.
hypotheses.reason: decide_nats_callout passes empty project_ids; eval ignores client-supplied memberships.

hypotheses.claim: Missing upstream token still yields allow via issuer/subject alone.
hypotheses.reason: evaluate_callout denies empty issuer/subject and unmapped principal; resolve_identity only allows dev profile when configured else Missing.

hypotheses.claim: Retry with same request_digest can change allow to broader permissions after policy update.
hypotheses.reason: decide records decision in host_kv via try_claim_host_kv; replay returns stored JSON including exp for allows.

result_one_line: Callout separates bridge mTLS, signed NATS request, and verified user JWT; evaluate_callout denies email-join and system subjects with replay-bound decisions.
